$description: TetherLog design tokens. Owned by this repo, no upstream. PHASE 3: the gravity-well direction from docs/LOOK.md. Dark ground (D-011), five-step type scale, self-hosted Geist. Every colour ratio below was computed, not estimated, and lives in its own $description so it travels with the value.

ground.$description: Deep space. Everything is measured from here. The starfield sits on this.

raised.$description: Navigation and ambient chrome. 1.10:1 on ground: a depth cue, not a boundary.

field.$description: The capture field at rest. Barely lighter than the ground, as docs/LOOK.md specifies. 1.24:1: deliberately not trying to pass anything.

field-focus.$description: The field with more mass. 1.44:1 on ground. Focus is carried by the rim, never by this alone.

base.$description: 18.08:1 on ground. Anything the user must read.

muted.$description: 8.60:1 on ground, 8.03:1 on field. Secondary copy that is still body text.

faint.$description: 4.22:1 on ground. NON-TEXT ONLY by policy, though it clears AA: reserved for marks and glyphs so the ink scale has a floor that cannot be mistaken for body copy.

rule.$description: 3.22:1 on ground. THE STRUCTURAL BOUNDARY. Any edge a user needs to see uses this and clears WCAG 1.4.11.

hairline.$description: 1.15:1. DECORATIVE ONLY. Never a boundary a user needs to perceive. See CLAUDE.md: this is the easiest mistake in the system to make.

base.$description: 6.21:1 on ground. The one colour per screen, on the primary action only.

high.$description: 8.36:1 on ground. The luminous rim and the focus indicator.

contrast.$description: Ground colour as the label on the accent fill: 6.21:1. Not pure white, which is banned.

rim.$description: The field rim at rest: accent.high at 56% over the field. 3.47:1 on ground and 3.24:1 on the field, so the edge of the capture field clears WCAG 1.4.11 on BOTH sides. Lower alphas were tried first and 24% measured 1.67:1, which is a decorative hairline pretending to be a boundary.

rim-focus.$description: The field rim on focus: accent.high at 78%. 5.53:1 on ground, 5.17:1 on the field. Visibly brighter than the rest rim in a still, which is the Phase 4 acceptance test. Not 100%: a full-strength accent ring would be a second appearance of the one colour per screen.

drop.$description: 5.11:1 on ground. Marker only, never the sole carrier of a state.

danger.$description: 8.52:1 on ground. Destructive only. Never a triage bucket.

base.$description: Tailwind v4 derives the WHOLE spacing scale from this single value. Never define individual --spacing-N alongside it; see CLAUDE.md.

radius.$description: Radius is generous. The 0px brutalist lock left with NIL and contradicts every reference in docs/LOOK.md.

field.$description: The capture field. Large and soft, per the closest reference.

width.$description: Down from 1.5px: the direction carries depth by what an object does to its surroundings, not by a drawn edge.

rim.$description: The luminous rim and the focus indicator.

body.$description: Self-hosted variable woff2, latin subset. Chosen 2026-09-18 by comparing four faces live on the screen, not on a specimen sheet. There is an @font-face for this in index.css: naming a font does not load it.

mono.$description: Two roles only: the parked count and the navigation. Self-hosted variable woff2.

size.$description: FIVE STEPS. Nothing on a screen may use a size that is not one of these. Locked in docs/LOOK.md.

micro.$description: Mono labels only: the parked count, the navigation.

input.$description: The capture field. NEVER smaller: it is the one place a person types while distracted.

light.$description: The display face. Not 200: at 200 a headline is spindly and the screen has no anchor.

medium.$description: The one action per screen, and section heads.

motion.$description: Direction-agnostic: these survive whichever look is chosen. Springs are {stiffness, damping, mass} and are solved at build time into CSS linear() easings by scripts/build-tokens.mjs. Zero runtime cost. Named for the moment in the arc they serve, never for their shape.

focus.$description: Is it listening? Zeta 1.000, ~230ms, no overshoot. Certainty, not personality.

commit.$description: Did it take it? Zeta 0.740, ~320ms, 3.2% overshoot. The ONLY token allowed to overshoot. Mass above 1 on purpose: a thought handed over should have weight.

settle.$description: Can I go now? Zeta 1.004, ~270ms. Starts at +120ms so it overlaps commit; total arc 420ms.

dismiss.$description: Leaving without ceremony: chip deselect, error clear, triage card exit. Zeta 1.010, ~200ms.

confirm.$description: How long the confirm word holds. Longer under reduced motion: with no travel, the word is carrying more of the answer.

standard.$description: Non-spring transitions: colour, opacity off the arc.

light.$description: The one light event in the application, at the handover. CLAUDE.md sets the budget: 320ms, peak 0.22 alpha. It does not fire under reduced motion, because a flash with no travel is a strobe.

commit-peak.$description: Peak alpha of the commit bloom around the well. Read by the lens as a uniform, never as a CSS property.

lens.$description: Tier 1 of the refraction lens (docs/DECISIONS.md D-016): the field's own body as a lit, refractive surface, ported from the approved reference artifact. Read by GravityField.tsx as WebGL uniforms, never as CSS. Star rendering (sky/starLayer) is untouched — this only governs the lens body itself.

rest.$description: Lens thickness at MASS_REST. Below this the refraction is barely visible; the approved artifact used the same value.

commit-peak.$description: Thickness at the top of the commit envelope, where mass also peaks. Interpolated from the existing mass arc, not a second timer.

dispersion.$description: Chromatic fringe amount at the rim, matching the approved demo's own 0.52 default. First pass shipped this at 0.35 out of undue caution; there is no product reason to restrain it, so it was raised to match what was actually signed off on.

specular-strength.$description: One fixed light source, upper-left, per docs/LOOK.md rule 2: one direction, everywhere. Full strength, matching the approved demo, which applied no separate damping scalar to its highlight.

rim-strength.$description: Brightness of the boundary the shader itself draws. This is the field's visible edge when the `glass` prop is active, replacing the CSS rim, so it carries the same WCAG-1.4.11 boundary duty D-002's --tl-rim does. Raised from a too-cautious 0.32: the real source video's rim is brighter and thicker than either build managed, and a muted rim was the opposite of the note it was meant to answer.

bloom-strength.$description: Soft glow behind the field so refraction has something to bend. Kept small and tight to the well: re-measure star contrast under the headline after any increase, same discipline as the sky() gains in GravityField.tsx.

sound.$description: The commit acknowledgment tone (docs/DECISIONS.md D-016). Synthesized in src/lib/sound.ts via Web Audio — no asset file, no network request. Off by default (AppSettings.soundEnabled); read as JS numbers, never CSS.

frequency-start.$description: Hz at the attack. A soft settle, not a chime: it falls rather than rings.

frequency-end.$description: Hz at release, one octave down — the pitch-drop reads as weight landing, matching the gravity-well metaphor.

gain-peak.$description: Peak volume. Quiet on purpose: acknowledgment, not celebration. Nothing rewards returning — see CLAUDE.md.

semantic.$description: Roles. Components read ONLY these. Names describe the job, never the palette, so a later direction change repoints them without renaming anything downstream.

rule.$description: 3.22:1. Every boundary a user needs to see.

hairline.$description: 1.15:1. Decorative only. Never a perceivable boundary.

mark-high.$description: The rim and the focus indicator.

rim.$description: The field edge at rest. A boundary a user must see: 3.24:1 against the field.

rim-focus.$description: The field edge on focus. The rim brightens; the bend deepens in the lens.

ease-standard.$description: Non-spring transitions: colour and opacity off the arc. Components may not read the primitive layer, so this role exists.

duration-confirm.$description: Read from JS for the confirm hold. A semantic exists so the reduced-motion override reaches a name a component is allowed to read.

light-commit-peak.$description: Read by the lens as a uniform. 0 under reduced motion.
